current_chain_id.meaning: Chain ID actually in effect on the chain after the fork / chain-ID change and used as the intended EIP-712 verification context.
current_chain_id.checkpoint: after fork, at EIP-712 verification time

deployment_chain_id.meaning: Chain ID permanently embedded in the DOMAIN_SEPARATOR that was computed once at deployment.

domain_separator_cached.meaning: Whether the contract computed and stored its EIP-712 DOMAIN_SEPARATOR once at deployment instead of deriving it from the current chain ID.

signatures_generated_on_new_chain.meaning: Whether the off-chain EIP-712 signatures submitted to depositToIntent / depositToIntentWithPermit were generated on the new chain.
signatures_generated_on_new_chain.checkpoint: after fork, before the deposit call

signature_valid.meaning: Observable outcome of validating a submitted signature against the contract's cached DOMAIN_SEPARATOR during depositToIntent / depositToIntentWithPermit.
signature_valid.checkpoint: during signature verification in depositToIntent / depositToIntentWithPermit

claims.scope: EIP-712 signature-based intent verification (depositToIntent, depositToIntentWithPermit) on a chain after a fork/chain ID change

preconditions.text: The TrailsIntentEntrypoint contract is deployed with its EIP-712 DOMAIN_SEPARATOR computed once in the constructor from block.chainid and stored as an immutable value.; After deployment, the chain forks or the chain ID changes.; Off-chain signatures are generated on the new chain for the signature-based flows such as depositToIntent and depositToIntentWithPermit.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Signature verification should be bound to the current chain ID so EIP-712 signatures remain valid after a chain fork or chain ID change.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: All off-chain signatures become invalid on the new chain, breaking the signature-based flows depositToIntent and depositToIntentWithPermit.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: Signatures used in depositToIntent and depositToIntentWithPermit are required to be generated with the same domain separator / chain ID that the contract uses for verification (as_signature_must_match).
depositToIntent and depositToIntentWithPermit share the same cached-DOMAIN_SEPARATOR EIP-712 verification path.
The fork / chain-ID change occurs after deployment and is external to the contract.

limitations: Permanent DoS of intent verification (i_permanent_dos) is deferred as a secondary consequence; this core plan selects i_signatures_invalid as the single direct impact.
Chain IDs are symbolic integers; no concrete fork chain ID is bound.
Permanence assumes no contract upgrade, redeployment or chain-ID-aware separator mitigates the issue.
Behavior of pre-fork signatures on the new chain and any replay implications are out of scope.
